note: Conceptual/technical lesson on drift detection — this is a statistical/analytical topic with no representative product UI to screenshot honestly, so per SCREENSHOTS.md's documented exception for non-visual lessons, no screenshot is used. The code slide presents the standard Population Stability Index formula shape and the widely-cited interpretive thresholds (<0.1 / 0.1-0.2 / >0.2) that appear consistently across industry and academic references on PSI; these are presented as a commonly used rule of thumb/convention, not an invented statistic or a claim of universal regulatory authority.
